task: Review source-backed constraints for a plan only: reuse SmartTube subtitles, use DeepSeek context batching, avoid stale callbacks and erroneous identity/timing assumptions. No implementation or completion certification.

checks.claim: The regular DASH path carries vssId in Format.id, but vssId alone cannot uniquely identify the selected subtitle among original and synthetic translated tracks.

The existing onTracksChanged callback loop does not emit an explicit subtitle-disabled event when the text TrackSelection is null; AI teardown cannot rely only on non-null subtitle onTrackChanged events.
Translations must be composed after the existing original subtitle normalization; feeding bilingual text through the stateful forceCenterAlignment can remove portions or newlines.
PR 5839 SubtitleTranslator is a processed-current-cue translation/merge implementation, not a 60-second context batch translator with stable timeline IDs.

Existing Subtitle event times and getCues define intervals in microseconds; SubtitleOutputBuffer adds subsample offsets. A new snapshot reader must respect those offsets rather than invent per-cue end timestamps.
